expected_claims.claim_text_normalized: The proposal network in Faster R-CNN reuses the same convolutional features that the downstream detector relies on, removing the separate proposal-generation cost present in earlier two-stage pipelines.
On a single GPU Faster R-CNN reaches roughly five frames per second and still attains leading detection accuracy on PASCAL VOC and MS COCO benchmarks.
Reference boxes that span several sizes and aspect ratios are placed at every spatial location, which lets the detector regress objects across a wide range of shapes from a single feature map.
Region proposals generated by Selective Search are the dominant runtime cost in earlier two-stage detectors and prevent end-to-end training; integrating an RPN removes this bottleneck.
